topFinding: EP Adopts Landmark Foreign Investment Screening Regulation and Condemns Taliban Criminalisation of Women's Education — Strategic Autonomy and Human Rights Dominate 19–21 May 2026 Plenary
keyTakeaways: EP10 demonstrates greater strategic coherence across policy domains than any previous parliament, coordinating economic security, human rights, and AI/trade governance in a single plenary session.
The FDI Screening Regulation (TA-10-2026-0171) completes a 7-year EU economic security reform cycle, aligning EU investment screening with US CFIUS and UK NSIA frameworks.
The Afghanistan resolution (TA-10-2026-0186) represents the most forceful EP language on Afghanistan since 2021, explicitly calling for UNSC referral to the ICC.

Approximately 30% of parliamentary activity remains invisible due to feed degradation (4/6 feeds unavailable), meaning this analysis covers formal adopted outputs but not the full parliamentary process.
The adopted texts signal EP negotiating priorities for MFF 2028-2034: larger defence envelope, rule-of-law conditionality, and integration of SAFE/ReArm Europe into structural spending.
